text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Rounding the 4th corner and into the final straight!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Go, Loves!
Just a little more! Hang in there, hold on till the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I hear them... I will definitely reward everyone's love!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I won't...!
I won't surrender the Tiara to anyone!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "I've finally made it this far—so I won't let you get away!"

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Curren Bouquetd'or!
Curren Bouquetd'or takes first place!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I... I won...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That was a wonderful run.
Congratulations, Bouquet-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much!
...Which means, really—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Delivered at last—the bouquet of victory...!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member C
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan... After all that hard work
to finally reach the Oaks...
*sniffle*... *hic*, waaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Loves worked so hard...
She gave it everything to return our love!"

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream Member B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Let's be grateful.
For her immense love!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Aha... Thanks for the warm applause, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I really wanted to deliver...
the greatest love to everyone...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Ah... right. It wasn't about breathing.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(The drama of the Oaks...
was already being woven.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(A story where Love-chan, who overcame
hardships alongside her fans, is the protagonist...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (If Love-chan is the protagonist—then what am I...?)

Chrono Genesis was lost in deep thought with a grave expression.
It seemed slightly different from merely brooding over defeat...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...No, I was simply
reflecting on the Genesis Method.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Bouquet-san's strong feelings for her cherished one...
became her Genesis Factor, and carried her to victory."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A touching drama where earnest feelings lead to victory...
Yet, on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"In the historical drama called the Oaks,
Love-chan was also a protagonist. And I was... just a supporting character."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The power of drama... and history,
was working upon the two of you...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: In truth, Love-chan grew by listening to the voices of her fans. Their cheers gave her strength...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...The influence of the Genesis Factor...
We'll need to re-evaluate it before the next Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, as I thought...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Even with a generous estimate of her future growth rate, the result at the Shuka Sho is..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: A victory for Loves-chan, or Bouquet-san...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The difference in the Genesis Factor between me and those two
will become a wall I cannot overcome—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (The Genesis Factor...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...Love-chan has the bonds she's nurtured over the years with her community of fans.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Bouquet-san's desire to deliver victory...
It's strong enough to support every stride of her running.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Gran-chan naturally possesses
gifted talent and unshakable confidence...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (...Still, I...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Even when creating a historical drama,
the Genesis Factor is indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The drama that fires up the fans only exists when there are factors worth considering...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Because of that, my historical predecessors...
drew history and destiny itself to their side...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Still, as for me... I don't have that.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I want to leave my hoofprints in history...
Yet, if asked whether that dream could become an obsession..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...*Pant*.
Trainer, I've finished the three sets.
choice_data_list: Well then, let's cool down and wrap things up.
Well then, let's cool down and finish up.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, I was thinking of doing
a bit more solo training..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I'd like to increase my independent
training not just today, but from now on as well...
Would that be all right...?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I want to forge my own weapon...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I don't have the Genesis Factor like Love-chan and the others, so...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "I want to grow strong enough to make up for whatever I'm lacking...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...To become a presence that even history,
even destiny itself would yearn to choose—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I feel that is the only way for me
to win the Shuka Sho...!"
choice_data_list: Then... I'll put together an independent training routine for you.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much!
I'm so sorry to trouble you...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I'll work that much harder, so...!

...I took on creating the menu
because I was worried about leaving it to her.

Her impatience has been showing through recently.
I suspect it's due to the future win rates calculated by the Genesis Method, but...
choice_data_list: (Words would only be cold comfort anyway...)

text_block_list.text:
I need to find a way to dispel her underlying anxiety
and help her regain her composure—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Nobody's coming, huh.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Looks like we can watch peacefully from here.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The fan voting results for the Takarazuka Kinen are—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
As expected, 1st place goes to Ai-san.
The top ranks seem virtually unchanged from the interim results.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Lilie-san is holding onto 9th place too! Hehe, I hope she decides to run...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! Gran-chan, that's amazing!!
If you'd registered, you might've been able to run...!?
